label: The Memory Harvest
summary: You come to Tamsel Vale to help bring in the harvest, and the first fruit you pick holds a memory of you that you do not have.
title: The Memory Harvest
description: A glass fruit from the old lord's orchard shows you laughing with someone you have never met, in a place you have never been.

chapterOutlines.title: First Picking
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive for the harvest, pick the strange fruit, meet the orchard keeper.

chapterOutlines.title: The Empty House
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out who used to live in the lord's house.

chapterOutlines.title: Lantern Night
chapterOutlines.outline: The valley's harvest festival, where memories are traded.

scene.location: The upper terraces of the old lord's orchard
scene.summary: Late afternoon light through glass branches. A single fruit, warmer than the rest, has just come away in your hand.

openThreads: Whose memory is in the fruit, and why are you in it?

npcs.name: Aurelio Venn
npcs.description: Has tended the old lord's trees alone for ten years and talks to them more than to people.
goals: Keep the orchard alive until the house has an heir
abilities: Can tell a fruit's memory by its color
